# FindMyPart Paid Part Hunt

Capability ID: findmypart-paid-hunt-v1
Commercial state: migration_hold
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/findmypart-paid-hunt-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- find a hard-to-source part
- identify this part
- find a discontinued part
- source an obsolete component
- find a donor or salvage part

## Problem

A difficult, ambiguous, obsolete, discontinued or hard-to-source part is blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project.

## Inputs

Part description plus any known equipment identity, model/serial/part numbers, photos, measurements or functional clues.

## Outputs

Evidence-backed sourcing hunt with candidate parts, source evidence, compatibility reasoning, sourcing options and escalation paths when ordinary sourcing fails.

## Pricing

Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.

- Quick Hunt:  (one_time)

- Deep Hunt:  (one_time)

- Rescue Hunt:  (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.

User must explicitly choose an offer and confirm payment. Paid fulfillment starts only after independently verified payment.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments with Stripe provider verification

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
